title: Meta Balanced Network for Fair Face Recognition
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmarks created and used in this paper (Identity Shades, BUPT-Globalface, BUPT-Balancedface) measure the degree of performance bias in face recognition algorithms with respect to different skin tones.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on skin tone bias in face recognition.
